note: Synthetic operations handbook for bench/kb. Every entity is invented. v2: wider tables and ten tool actions.

policies.name: Incident severity
policies.text: Sev 1 is customer-visible downtime, paged immediately to the owning team. Sev 2 is degraded service, acknowledged within 30 minutes. Sev 3 is cosmetic and handled in business hours.

policies.name: Deploy freeze
policies.text: No production deploys during the last two business days of the quarter, except for Sev 1 fixes approved by the owning team lead.

policies.name: Data retention
policies.text: Application logs are kept 30 days. Audit logs are kept 400 days. Customer records are deleted within 30 days of a verified request.

policies.name: Oncall handoff
policies.text: Oncall rotates weekly on Monday at 09:00 in the team lead timezone, with a written handoff in the team channel.

policies.name: Access review
policies.text: Production access is reviewed quarterly. Any access unused for 90 days is revoked automatically.

policies.name: Cost guardrail
policies.text: Any service above 2,000 dollars a month in compute needs a named owner and a monthly review.

policies.name: Search relevance
policies.text: Every relevance change ships behind a traffic split of at least 5%, held for 72 hours before full rollout.

policies.name: Payment retries
policies.text: Failed charges retry three times over 48 hours with exponential backoff, then settle to manual review.

policies.name: Secrets rotation
policies.text: Service credentials rotate every 90 days. Database credentials rotate every 30 days. A rotation that fails pages the Security oncall.

policies.name: Backup testing
policies.text: Every production database restore is tested monthly into a scratch environment, and the result is attached to the runbook.

policies.name: Customer escalation
policies.text: A customer marked priority one gets an engineer on the call within 15 minutes. Priority two gets a written update within four hours.

policies.name: Change windows
policies.text: Routine changes ship Monday through Thursday between 09:00 and 16:00 in the service region. Friday changes need a rollback plan.

policies.name: Incident review
policies.text: Every Sev 1 gets a written review within five business days, and the action items are tracked to closure by the owning team.

policies.name: Feature flags
policies.text: A flag older than 90 days is either made permanent or removed. Flags that gate a payment path need an owner and an expiry.

policies.name: Documentation freshness
policies.text: A runbook untouched for 180 days is marked stale and routed to its owning team for review.

policies.name: Third party integrations
policies.text: Every external integration has a named owner, a fallback path when it is down, and a quarterly health check.
